When God created boys and girls, He tipped his hat to this noblest of professions. He knew the value of creating opportunities. Let’s go. It’s time. This is a sorry business. It’s your lover's bedroom you need, not your grave.

@@U01582@@
What good is heaven's joy in her arms; what good warming myself at her breast, when all I feel is her need, her misery, always? What am I, what, but a homeless fugitive, a monster who without peace or purpose plunges like a cataract in greedy rage from rock to rock into the abyss? And there, at the side, in her little hut, on her tiny Alpine meadow, dreaming childlike dreams in her little world, she knows nothing, nothing of the world outside. And I, hated of God, couldn't be satisfied with seizing the rocks and smashing them to bits— I had to ruin her peace! You, Hell, you, you had to have this sacrifice! Devil, Devil, help me cut short this anguish! Let happen what has to happen, let it happen now! Let her fate be my fate, let it fall crushingly down upon me, and hurl us to a single doom!

@@U01584@@
Mercy, what a stew he’s in, all hot and bothered! Go on, go, go comfort her, you fool! Let a blockhead arrive at his wits’ end
translation:
@@U01580@@
当上帝创造男孩和女孩时，他向这个最高尚的职业致敬。他知道创造机会的价值。我们走吧。是时候了。这是一件令人遗憾的事情。你需要的是你爱人的卧室，而不是你的坟墓。

@@U01582@@
天堂的欢乐在她的怀抱里有什么好处；当我总是感觉到她的需要、她的痛苦时，在她的怀里取暖有什么好处呢？我是什么，什么，只是一个无家可归的逃亡者，一个没有平静或目标的怪物，像一个贪婪的愤怒中的瀑布一样从岩石到岩石坠入深渊？而在旁边，在她的小屋里，在她小小的高山草甸上，她在她的小世界里做着孩子般的梦想，她对外面的世界一无所知。而我，憎恨上帝，不能满足于抓住岩石并将它们砸成碎片——我必须破坏她的平静！你，地狱，你，你必须做出这样的牺牲！恶魔，恶魔，帮我结束这痛苦吧！让该发生的事情发生吧，让它现在发生！让她的命运就是我的命运，让她的命运压倒在我身上，让我们陷入厄运！

@@U01584@@
天哪，他现在处境多么糟糕，又热又烦恼！快去快去安慰她啊笨蛋！让傻瓜束手无策
